input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so the Customer Data-processing trigger is satisfied; Customer Data is broadly defined at 1.3), workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates of insurance on request under 18.2. The clause adds further Customer-favourable terms (employer's liability, a one-year tail, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and non-limitation of Vendor's liabilities). No redline required.
